content: Hello! how can I help today?
I own several rental properties and work full-time in real estate. Can I deduct my passive losses?

Yes—if you qualify as a **real estate professional** under §469(c)(7). You must:
1. Spend over 750 hours in real estate trades or businesses
2. Perform more than half of your personal services in real estate

Then, losses are **not subject to PAL limits** and can offset ordinary income.
Do I need to materially participate too?
Correct. In addition to real estate professional status, you must **materially participate** in each rental activity or aggregate them under a valid election on **Form 8582**.
What kind of records should I keep?
Maintain a **contemporaneous time log** showing hours, dates, and activity types. Include emails, calendars, and invoices to substantiate the 750-hour threshold and material participation.
Where do I report the losses?
Use **Schedule E**, and complete **Form 8582** to show you’re exempt from passive limits. If done correctly, these losses can significantly reduce your adjusted gross income.
